entries.0c5ffcd9870486aa: This is the group's core business, wholesaling plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment to building materials retailers and building contractors. Its core company, JK Building Materials Co., Ltd., is the largest operating company, with revenue accounting for more than 10% of consolidated revenue. It is composed of 12 companies in total: 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 unconsolidated subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥331,072 million.
entries.0f25119d44b5082e: Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing Business
entries.122ed69d9777a003: This business manufactures and sells ordinary plywood, structural plywood, long-length plywood and structural LVL “Keyram” made mainly from softwood, and also manufactures and sells laminated lumber and secondary plywood products, and processes and sells lumber. The core company is Keytec Co., Ltd., and the business consists of 10 consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,342 million.
